subject: Draft: Fusion Pod announcement + QBR alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Fusion Pod announcement + QBR alignment

Team —

I pulled together a short announcement and a QBR slide stub that explain the planned consolidation of the "Search Infra" and "Serving Runtime" squads into a single Fusion Pod (draft rationale, reporting changes, and immediate owner responsibilities attached). Key asks: please review for gaps in tone, timing, or operational risk.

High-level intent:
- Combine two closely coupled squads to reduce duplicate on-call and speed feature rollouts.
- Keep current OKRs but retire overlapping roadmap items; Fusion Pod will take ownership of cross-cutting latency and cost OKRs.
- Keep most IC reporting lines stable; two manager-level role moves (named below) so we can simplify escalation paths.

Draft timeline (proposed):
- Sep 14: Exec readout (leadership only)
- Sep 16: Leadership final sign-off
- Sep 21: All-staff announcement + updated org doc
- Oct 1: Operational handover complete (on-call & runbooks)

Open items I want your input on:
1) Communication tone — does the draft strike the right balance (calm, decisive, practical)?
2) OKR mapping — are there top-three metrics we should explicitly call out in the QBR slides so we don’t lose focus?
3) Timing risks — will Sep 21 create any deliverable conflicts for ongoing releases?

Attachments: [Attachment: fusion-pod-announcement-draft.docx] (also in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/fusion-pod-announcement-draft)

Please give quick edits or replies by end of day Friday (Sep 4). If you prefer inline edits in the doc, drop them there and I’ll fold them in.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Fusion Pod announcement + QBR alignment

Thanks for the draft, Soojin — good framing. A few inline notes and high-level concerns:

- Tone: I like the "practical" approach. Suggest adding one sentence up front that this is an operational consolidation (not a headcount reduction) — we should preempt the standard "reorg" anxiety.
- Timeline: Sep 21 for all-staff is fine, but we need to confirm that the Serving Runtime team does not have a mid-Sep release freeze window. If they do, we should move the public announcement 1 week later.
- OKRs: call out three explicit metrics in the QBR slides: median 99th latency for inference, cost per 1M tokens (normalized), and mean time to recovery for production incidents.

Minor edits are in the attached doc (I left comments on the manager transitions paragraph).

Quick technical flag from infra: combining teams is the right direction, but we need to call out two operational tasks explicitly in the announcement (or in an appendix) so the SRE and runtime teams can plan:
1) On-call re-mapping and ownership during the 2-week overlap window — we should publish a temporary runbook and paging matrix by Sep 28.
2) KV cache eviction/config handoffs — this requires a short coordination sprint between the two teams to avoid a performance regression.

If we surface those as "near-term actions" in the announcement (and link to the runbook in the Drive), it will reduce surprise and give teams a clear next step.

Also — please include Customer Success in the readout invite (I can loop them into the runbook drafting).
